 Lincoln to offer free bus, bike rides on Election Day 
 More GOP leadership stops by Nebraska, Halloween in the Haymarket is happening tonight, and more By Abigail Carrera Published : Oct. 21, 2026 at 12:21 PM CDT | Updated : 1 hour ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LINCOLN, Neb. (KOLN) - The City of Lincoln will offer free bicycle and bus rides on Election Day, Tuesday, Nov. 3.
 StarTran will waive fares for bus and paratransit services, allowing riders to board at no cost.
 The city encourages people to use the RideLNK app to plan their trip and track the buses. Information on riding StarTran is available at lincoln.ne.gov/transit .
 Additionally, people can get free bike rides through BikeLNK by downloading the BCycle App and using promo code VOTE26 when purchasing a Capital Cruiser pass. This pass offers unlimited one-hour trips within 24 hours of signing up.
 “Getting to the polls can look different for everyone, and we want to make that trip easier,” said Hunter Arias, BikeLNK City Manager. “By offering free bus rides and bike share on Election Day, we’re giving people more transportation options to travel to the polls.” 
 Voters can find their polling place at votercheck.necvr.ne.gov/VoterView .
